LanguageData.VRF_Settings_Title: Vehicle Raid Framework - Natural Raid Settings
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_NoVehicles: No vehicle kinds found. Make sure Vehicle Framework and a vehicle mod are loaded.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_FactionListDesc: Select a faction to configure which vehicles can appear in their natural raids.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_VehicleListDesc: Vehicles for faction: {0}. Check a vehicle to allow it to appear in natural raids.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_VehicleActive: This vehicle will appear in natural raids from this faction.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_VehicleInactive: This vehicle will not appear in natural raids.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_Tip_CombatPower: Point cost the storyteller spends to include this vehicle when composing a raid. Higher values mean fewer of this type will appear in low-budget raids.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_Tip_MinPoints: Minimum raid points required for this vehicle to be eligible. Below this threshold the storyteller will not select it.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_Tip_MaxPoints: Upper raid point limit above which this vehicle stops appearing. Useful to prevent light vehicles from showing up in high-difficulty raids. Set to 0 for no limit.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_Tip_Estimator: These multipliers define how Auto-fill estimates each vehicle's combat power. The formula sums: (HP × WeightHP) + (Armor × WeightArmor) + (DPS × WeightDPS) + (Range × WeightRange) + (Speed × WeightSpeed) + (Drivers × WeightDrivers) + (Gunners × WeightGunners) + (Passengers × WeightPassengers) + (Size × WeightSize).
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_Tip_AirMultiplier: Extra multiplier applied to the total estimated combat power for air vehicles (helicopters, airplanes). Increase it if air vehicles feel undervalued compared to ground ones.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_Tip_Budget: Points assigned by the mod to purchase vehicles in this context. The mod will pick enabled vehicles by combat power cost until this budget is exhausted. Vehicles with 'Force spawn' are always added regardless of budget.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_Tip_GlobalStrategy: Controls which raid strategies can spawn vehicles globally. If a strategy is unchecked here, no vehicle will be injected into that type of raid, regardless of per-vehicle settings. Per-vehicle strategy filters apply on top of this as an additional restriction.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_GlobalStrategyHint: Unchecked strategies block all vehicles from spawning in that raid type.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_Tip_VehicleRaidChance: Percentage chance (0% to 100%) that a natural enemy raid will include vehicles. At 100%, all eligible raids attempt to spawn vehicles. At 0%, no natural raids will include vehicles.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_VehiclePointsFractionTitle: % of raid points assigned to vehicles
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_AutoFillAmmoFractionTitle: % of cargo capacity filled with ammo (Auto-fill)
LanguageData.VRF_StrategyDialog_Hint: Checked strategies allow this vehicle to spawn. Unchecked ones block it.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_ClearConfirm: Reset all faction vehicle settings? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_UpgradesDesc: Add upgrade options. One is chosen at random when the vehicle spawns. Grayed-out upgrades require unmet prerequisites.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_CopiedList: Vehicle list for "{0}" copied to clipboard.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_PasteConfirm: Paste vehicle list from "{0}" into "{1}"? Existing entries for matching vehicles will be overwritten.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_ClearFactionConfirm: Reset all vehicle settings for faction "{0}"? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_AutoFillConfirm: Auto-fill all vehicles for faction "{0}"? This will enable every vehicle and calculate combat power from their stats (HP, armor, turrets, speed, crew, size). Existing values will be overwritten.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_FactionListDesc_Settlement: Select a faction to configure which vehicles spawn at their settlements.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_FactionListDesc_Outpost: Select a faction to configure which vehicles spawn at their outposts/mission sites.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_FactionListDesc_Ambush: Select a faction to configure which vehicles spawn during ambushes.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_ForceSpawnDesc: This vehicle will always spawn regardless of available budget. Auto-fill ignores this flag.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_HoverDesc: Configure hover properties for vehicles that have a hover component. Changes apply immediately to the vehicle def in memory and are saved to your settings.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_NoHoverVehicles: No vehicles with a hover component were found. Make sure a hover-capable vehicle mod is loaded.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_HoverNative: This vehicle has a native hover component.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_HoverOverride: No native hover — config stored as override.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_AutoFillSiegeDropDesc: When enabled, Auto-fill will include siege-drop pod vehicles (e.g. Goliath) and mark them as isSiegeDrop automatically. Disabled by default since they require drop-arrival raids to work correctly.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_SiegeDropOnlyDesc: When enabled, vehicles marked as siege-drop pods will only appear in raids that use a drop-arrival mode (CenterDrop, EdgeDrop, etc.). They will be skipped for walking or edge-walk arrivals.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_IsSiegeDropDesc: Mark this as a siege-drop pod (like the Goliath). It will NOT have hover/helicopter mode injected and will be allowed to spawn during drop-arrival raids. Auto-fill enables this automatically for detected siege pods.
LanguageData.VRF_Settings_ThrusterConfigDesc: Adjust the hover speed contributed by each thruster. The total gravship speed is the sum of all active thrusters.
